title: Fragment.rcs field present but only valid for All-1 fragments
description:
## Location
- /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/schc/src/fragment/wire.rs lines 237-252

## Problem
The Fragment struct always contains an `rcs: [u8; RCS_LENGTH]` field:

```rust
pub struct Fragment<a, const M: u8, const N: u8, const T: u8> {
    // ...
    pub rcs: [u8; RCS_LENGTH],
}
```

For non-All-1 fragments, this field MUST be `[0; RCS_LENGTH]` per the protocol. This invariant is enforced in `write_to`:

```rust
if self.rcs != [0; RCS_LENGTH] {
    return Err(FragmentError::InvalidRcs);
}
```

## API Risk
Callers constructing Fragment manually can easily set a non-zero RCS for regular fragments, which then fails at serialization time. The error happens late (at write_to), not at construction.

## Suggested Fix
Either:
1. Use a newtype/enum that makes RCS presence type-safe: `enum FragmentPayload { Regular(payload), Final { payload, rcs } }`
2. Add a constructor that validates the invariant
3. Document prominently that rcs must be zeroed for non-All-1 fragments

Option 1 is cleanest but a breaking change.
close_reason: Added doc comment to Fragment.rcs explaining it is only valid when is_all_1() returns true
